P_calibration.quote: Exploration licenses don't authorize commercial recovery, so this exemption either does nothing or (as a court would likely read it, to give it effect) allows unlimited mining

P_grandfather_step.quote: The 180-day delay is a license-rush window. Combined with Sec. 3(b), the delay gives NOAA, the ISA, and foreign states six months to issue instruments while the bill is law but not in force
